name: Vesper
title: Infernal Shadowblade
build: Arcane Tankster, adapted for a four-player co-op party
role: Hit-and-run striker in medium armour and a shield: Dash in, Booming Blade, back off so enemies take thunder chasing her. Also thief, scout and control enabler.

arc.before: How do I get in, take what I need, and get out?
arc.after: How do I make sure nobody ever gets into me again?

level_order: Rogue 1–5, then Wizard 1–4, then Rogue 6–7, then Wizard 5

choices.label: Background
choices.text: Urchin (gives Sleight of Hand and Stealth)

choices.label: Abilities
choices.text: STR 8 · DEX 17 · CON 14 · INT 16 · WIS 10 · CHA 8

levels.play: Finesse weapon and light armour. Vesper is the party's lock, trap and scouting specialist.

levels.gains: Cunning Action: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
levels.play: Dash becomes the start of her hit-and-run turn once she has the Speedy Lightfeet. Disengage when backing off would be too risky.

warnings: Tasha's Hideous Laughter is a placeholder. You replace it at level 4.
Disguise Self is her disguise for theft. Keep Mask of the Shapeshifter in reserve.
Set the Sneak Attack reaction to Ask, so it lands on a Booming Blade hit.
levels.gains: Mage Hand Legerdemain, Sneak Attack 2d6, and spellcasting.
levels.play: Booming Blade becomes the default melee attack.

levels.gains: Medium armour and shield proficiency. Thunderwave is always prepared.
levels.play: Put on medium armour and a shield. The Speedy Lightfeet can now be worn.

levels.gains: Uncanny Dodge, Sneak Attack 3d6, and Booming Blade adds 1d8 thunder.
levels.play: Big survival jump. Magic Missile is always prepared for ranged cleanup.

warnings: Don't scribe Chromatic Orb or Fog Cloud. You learn them free at level 7.
Find Familiar: prepare it, summon, then unprepare it. The familiar stays.

prepare.note: Ice Knife and Burning Hands are flex picks from scribed scrolls.

levels.gains: Spellbook, Arcane Recovery, and level 1 scroll scribing.
levels.play: Friends is theft insurance, not face duty. Start scribing level 1 scrolls.

choices.label: Spells
choices.text: the two level 1 spells you held back

warnings: Hold back two level 1–2 spells for level 9's free picks. The default is Blur and Web.

prepare.note: Swap Hold Person for Web when the fight isn't against humanoids.

levels.gains: Arcane Ward and level 2 scroll scribing.
levels.play: Abjuration spells charge the Ward, Counterspell always gives 3, and Shield gives none. At 0 charges, Booming Blade refills it to her Wizard level. Scribe level 2 scrolls straight away.

warnings: Neither spell has a scroll. Take both now, or you can't get them.

prepare.note: Swap Protection from Evil and Good for Web as needed. At this level you can cast Shadow Blade, then unprepare it.

levels.gains: Shadow Blade: her signature weapon, 2d8 psychic.
levels.play: Big breakpoint. Booming Blade with Shadow Blade, then Sneak Attack.

choices.label: Spells
choices.text: or any two level 1–2 spells you held back

warnings: From now on, keep Shadow Blade prepared. Unpreparing it drops an upcast blade to 2d8.
Counterspell has no scroll. Take it at level 12.

prepare.note: Swap in Hold Person, Haste, Hypnotic Pattern, Web or Fireball when the fight calls for it.

levels.gains: DEX 20: +1 AC in her full-DEX armour, +1 to hit, damage and initiative. Level 3 scroll scribing. Shadow Blade reaches 3d8 from a 3rd-level slot.
levels.play: Cast Shadow Blade with a 3rd-level slot.
Spotting traps and talking her way out of a caught theft both get much more reliable.

choices.label: Replace spell (optional)
choices.text: only if you'll use Mask of the Shapeshifter for disguises from now on

warnings: Mirror Image is now always prepared. Take it out of the Wizard list.

prepare.note: If you swapped Disguise Self for Misty Step, Misty Step is always prepared too: prepare Protection from Evil and Good in its place.

levels.gains: Evasion, Sneak Attack 4d6, and Booming Blade adds 2d8 thunder.
levels.play: Evasion turns many Dexterity-save explosions into no damage.

choices.label: Spells
choices.text: Counterspell is a must. Remove Curse is a flex pick: any level 3 spell you don't know yet.

warnings: Counterspell has no scroll. Don't skip it.

prepare.note: If Misty Step is already an Arcane Trickster spell, prepare Fear instead. Swap Slow for Fear, Hold Person, Blindness or Haste by fight.

levels.gains: Counterspell, 8 Wizard preparations, and level 4 scroll scribing.
levels.play: Use the one 4th-level slot on Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer or Fire Shield. A 3rd-level slot is enough for Shadow Blade.

scrolls.intro: Steal or collect one copy of every Wizard scroll. Scribe each spell level as soon as she can, and keep duplicates to cast straight from the scroll.

tiers.note: Scribe every useful level 1 scroll you find; these two are her flex picks. She already learns Find Familiar, Enhance Leap, Protection from Evil and Good, Mage Armour, Feather Fall and Grease at level 6. Hold back two to learn free at level 7.
Hold back two level 1–2 spells to learn free at level 9. If you want Web sooner, scribe it and hold back a different spell.
Scribe these as soon as she reaches level 9. Leave one level 3 spell unscribed for level 12's free pick.
Her one 4th-level slot makes these worth carrying.

cannot_learn.note: It has no scroll, and a level 5 Wizard can't learn it, so this split never gets it.

illithid.intro: Optional. The build works without the tadpole. These are the picks that fit if you want the extra power.
illithid.warning: Awakened turns illithid powers into bonus actions, but her bonus action already goes to Cunning Dash in her hit-and-run turn.

powers.why: Illithid powers cost a bonus action instead of an action. You get it by succeeding at the Zaith'isk.
Adds psychic damage, which fits her mental-debuff plan.
Finishes off low-HP enemies and can chain through a group.
Temporary HP for her, and it can stun nearby enemies.
Pulls enemies together for control spells and bombs.
Psychic area damage that can stun.
Weakens mental saves, which suits her control spells.

gear.note: +1d4 to ability checks while disguised. Share with the Druid.
gear.claim: Shared: swap with whoever is shapeshifting.

gear.note: Guidance when the Druid isn't nearby.
Advantage on Sleight of Hand. Theft kit, not combat gloves.
+2 Stealth and Sleight of Hand for stealing, locks and traps.
In reserve: she learns Disguise Self. Use the Mask if you replace Disguise Self at level 11.
Cunning Dash gives 3 Lightning Charges every turn of her hit-and-run loop. Needs medium armour proficiency.
Her Act 1 weapon: crits on 19–20, rerolls low damage, Advantage on obscured targets.
gear.claim: Vesper until Shadow Blade at level 8, then the Warlock if they fight in melee. The Ranger's melee slot holds the Club of Hill Giant Strength.

gear.note: Finesse longsword fallback. Any teammate can pull it from the stone (DC 15 Strength or Religion) and hand it over.
Silences a caster it hits if they fail a Constitution save.
Her first Mithral craft: +2 AC, crit immunity, and melee attackers that miss become Reeling.
gear.claim: The forge only has Mithral for two items in the whole game.

gear.note: Act 1 armour (18 AC) if the second Mithral is hers. Gives Disadvantage on Stealth.
gear.claim: Party decision: the second of only two Mithral crafts.

gear.note: Act 1 armour if the Mithral goes elsewhere: AC 15, no Stealth Disadvantage.
With Lightning Charges from her Dash, attackers must save or be Shocked.
Undead that hit her take radiant damage. Swap it out against beasts.
Necrotic hit-back while she's in shadow, but low AC.

Thunder and radiant damage (Booming Blade from level 5, Holy Lance Helm, Thunderwave) stack Reverberation: −1 to STR, DEX and CON saves per turn, and at 5 the target may fall Prone. Lightning Charges don't trigger it.
+1 AC: the survival swap for Act 1 gloves.
Enemies that miss her take radiant damage, which also stacks Reverberation.
Healing she receives is maximised. Great with potions thrown by Mage Hand.
Booming Blade turns it on every turn: +3 damage (her INT modifier) on weapon hits.
On Tactician, Booming Blade's thunder adds +1d4 thunder to her next weapon hit.
+1 AC and saves: the survival swap for either ring. Mol's reward for stealing the idol.
Bonus-action Misty Step each short rest, and immunity to webs, grease and ice. Great for getting away after a hit.
8 temporary HP when she casts a concentration spell.
Its +1d4 to hit and damage against Frightened targets covers all her weapon attacks. Check in game that it works from the ranged slot.
+1 AC and less physical damage, but she carries a shield.
Retribution off-hand from the Reddit build. She carries a shield.
The Reddit build's bomb trick. Bombs are her last resort.
Booming Blade hits give Arcane Acuity, raising her spell attack and save DC. Wear until Braindrain.
+1d4 fire on every weapon hit.
Enemies that fail her saves get Mental Fatigue, weakening their mental saves.
Psychic hits apply Mental Fatigue. With Shadow Blade, every hit counts.
+1d4 weapon damage against obscured targets, which Shadow Blade already wants.
Melee attackers who hit her take acid damage. Her Act 2 cloak.
+1 AC and +1 to all saves: the survival swap.
+1 AC: the survival swap for her boots.
Restore one spell slot of any level, once per long rest.
Act 2 armour: 15 + her full DEX (19, then 20 at DEX 20), no Stealth Disadvantage, +1 initiative.

gear.name: Resonance Stone
gear.where: Mind Flayer Colony, near the Mind-Archive interface.
gear.note: Its aura gives psychic vulnerability and mental-save Disadvantage to everyone nearby, friends included. Carry it only when the party is clear.
+2 AC, +1 spell DC and attack, Advantage on DEX saves.
gear.claim: Stars Druid may have the stronger claim. The Adamantine Shield is her fallback.

gear.note: 17 + her full DEX (22 at DEX 20) and +2 to all saves. Her endgame armour.
gear.claim: Vesper. Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail is the fallback for anyone else.

gear.note: 16 + full DEX: her fallback if Armour of Agility goes elsewhere.
+2 to hit, initiative and Perception.
+1 AC and saves, immunity to crits and stuns, 2 HP back each turn: the survival swap.
+1 spell save DC and spell attack for her control spells, plus Absorb Elements.
Attacks against her have Disadvantage until she takes damage: the survival swap.
+1d6 fire on weapon hits and +1 spell DC and attack.
+1d4 force on Sneak Attack and +1 initiative. Early in Act 3.
Freedom of Movement and Longstrider, at the cost of Lightning Charges.
Can't be pushed, and can turn a failed save into a success. Uses her reaction.
23 CON and Advantage on CON saves.

gear.note: Advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves.
After a weapon hit, cast an illusion or enchantment spell as a bonus action, but that bonus action is the one her Dash uses.
+3 AC, Advantage on saves against spells, and enemy spell attacks get Disadvantage. Her final shield.
Heavy armour (21 AC). She stays in medium armour.
gear.claim: Free for the Warlock if they want it.

gear.note: The Reddit build's no-shield clothing. She wears medium armour.
Only work without armour or a shield.
Its attack costs her action, which competes with Booming Blade.
No-shield off-hand. She carries a shield.

gear.claim: Gloom Stalker or Warlock. Shadow Blade already gives Vesper Advantage on obscured targets.
Gloom Stalker: +2 acid on every one of many attacks.

loadouts.label: Act 1
loadouts.intro: From level 4, once Moderately Armoured gives her medium armour and shields. Take the theft pieces off after shopping.

slots.note: Misses against her deal radiant damage, which the gloves turn into Reverberation.
Nothing worth the slot in Act 1.
Only if the party gives her the second Mithral; it also gives Disadvantage on Stealth. Breastplate +1 is the no-Mithral pick.
From level 5. Swap to Thievery for stealing.
Silver Pendant gives Guidance when the Druid isn't nearby.
Swap to the Boon ring while disguised.
Swap to Smuggler's for stealing, locks and traps.
Finesse, so Sneak Attack works. Hand the Knife on when Shadow Blade arrives at level 8.

loadouts.armour_class: Adamantine Scale Mail 18 + Adamantine Shield 2 = 20 AC (19 with Breastplate +1). Wondrous Gloves and Ring of Protection add 1 each when survival matters more. Shield adds +5 when needed.

loadouts.label: Act 2
loadouts.intro: Shadow Blade arrives at level 8. Until then, keep the Act 1 weapon.

slots.note: 15 + her full DEX, no Stealth Disadvantage, +1 initiative. Adamantine Scale Mail trades 1 AC for crit immunity and 1 less damage per hit.
Braindrain comes at the very end of the act. Until then, wear Battlemage's Power.
From level 9, cast it with a 3rd-level slot for 3d8.
Ketheric's Shield if the Druid passes on it.

loadouts.armour_class: Yuan-Ti Scale Mail 19 + shield 2 = 21 AC, 22 once DEX reaches 20 at level 9. Cloak of Protection, Evasive Shoes and Ring of Protection add 1 each when survival matters more.

loadouts.label: Act 3
loadouts.intro: Damage and debuffs first, in medium armour and a shield. The survival swaps sit in each slot's alternates.

slots.note: Cast with a 3rd-level slot for 3d8 psychic.

loadouts.armour_class: Armour of Agility 22 (at DEX 20) + Viconia's Walking Fortress 3 = 25 AC. Helm of Balduran and Ring of Protection add 1 each, and Cloak of Displacement gives attackers Disadvantage, when survival matters more. Shield adds +5 when needed.

turn: Cunning Action: Dash toward the target. The Speedy Lightfeet give 3 Lightning Charges.
Booming Blade with Shadow Blade, and add Sneak Attack on the hit.
Use the rest of her movement to back away, so the target has to move to reach her and takes Booming Blade's thunder.
Backing away draws opportunity attacks: Uncanny Dodge halves the first hit, and AC, Shield and the Arcane Ward soak the rest. Misses trigger Holy Lance Helm and the Adamantine Shield.
If an opportunity attack would be too dangerous, use Cunning Disengage instead of Dash.
Bombs are a last resort. From level 11, Evasion makes point-blank bombs safe for her, but not for her friends.
start_of_day: Ask the Gloom Stalker for Longstrider: more movement for running in and back out.
Prepare the Wizard spells for her level, then swap freely out of combat.
From level 8, cast Shadow Blade. From level 9, use a 3rd-level slot.
Before a theft: Boon ring, cast Disguise Self, then theft ring and gloves.
Decide whether the Resonance Stone is safe to carry today.
theft: Put on Shapeshifter's Boon Ring, then cast Disguise Self (or use Mask of the Shapeshifter if you swapped at level 11).
Put on Smuggler's Ring and Gloves of Thievery. If she might need Friends, get Guidance from the Druid; she can't concentrate on both.
Split from the group and Hide. Keep your friends out of the crime scene.
Steal at least one copy of every Wizard scroll you find.
After a successful pickpocket, leave before the victim notices.
If caught and given a dialogue check, pick Deception and cast Friends on that person for Advantage.
On Tactician, Friends can anger its target when it ends. Leave, camp or fast-travel before the 10 turns run out. Never use Friends on companions.
If you keep getting caught, slip away instead of escalating.

reactions.name: Sneak Attack
reactions.why: Put it on the Booming Blade hit, not a weak one.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.why: Spend the slot only when +5 AC changes the result. It gives no Arcane Ward charges.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.why: Skip harmless casts. It always gives 3 Arcane Ward charges.

reactions.name: Hellish Rebuke
reactions.why: Low priority: weak with her Charisma.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.why: Halves the first hit each round, including the opportunity attacks she draws when backing off.

reactions.name: Rebuke of the Mighty (Viconia's)
reactions.why: Never let it take the reaction you need for Shield or Counterspell.

reactions.name: Infernal Evasion (Helldusk Boots)
reactions.why: Only when the failed save is truly dangerous.

mage_hand: Scout dangerous rooms while it's invisible. It turns visible when it acts and goes invisible again on a short rest.
Drop a potion for the Hand to throw to an ally.
Stand it next to an enemy to count as the ally Sneak Attack needs.
